# md-serve smoke test

This file exists so the smoke test has something to render.

## GFM features

- [x] task list item (checked)
- [ ] task list item (unchecked)
- regular bullet

| col A | col B |
| ----- | ----- |
| 1     | 2     |
| 3     | 4     |

~~strikethrough~~ and `inline code`.

```go
func main() {
    fmt.Println("hello")
}
```
